```{ojs}
{
  const g = (m, k, fy) => TR.find(d => d.sec === k && d.fy === fy && d.m === m).unw;
  const pc = (m, k, a, b) => g(m, k, b) / g(m, k, a) - 1;
  const four = ["pr", "pm", "pb"], pub = ["pr", "pm", "pb", "cc"];
  const ff = four.map(k => pc("facfte", k, 2000, 2012)), nf = four.map(k => pc("nonfacfte", k, 2000, 2012));
  const fa = pub.map(k => pc("facfte", k, 2013, 2024)), n2 = pub.map(k => pc("nonfacfte", k, 2013, 2024));
  const rng = a => `${pct0(d3.min(a))} to ${pct0(d3.max(a))}`.replaceAll("-", "−");
  return md`<div class="cs-lead">The 2014 Delta Cost brief found that public colleges had been <b>shedding staff relative to students</b> from 2000 to 2012. In the four-year public sectors that decline was <b>almost all non-faculty</b>: non-faculty FTE per student changed ${rng(nf)} over FY2000–12 while faculty FTE changed ${rng(ff)}; community colleges lost both (faculty ${pct0(pc("facfte", "cc", 2000, 2012)).replace("-", "−")}, non-faculty ${pct0(pc("nonfacfte", "cc", 2000, 2012)).replace("-", "−")}). Then it reversed. From FY2013 to FY2024 <b>both rose in every public sector</b>: faculty FTE per student by ${rng(fa)}, non-faculty FTE by ${rng(n2)}. Community colleges went from ${f0(g("nonfacfte", "cc", 2013))} to ${f0(g("nonfacfte", "cc", 2024))} non-faculty FTE per 1,000 students and from ${f0(g("facfte", "cc", 2013))} to ${f0(g("facfte", "cc", 2024))} faculty FTE.</div>`;
}
```

Read more: [white paper §2](../paper/index.qmd#sec-2) (the Delta Cost brief), [§3](../paper/index.qmd#sec-3) (data and the replication) and [§4](../paper/index.qmd#sec-4) (staffing and spending since 2012). Substack post: Post 1 (link on publication).
:::

Pick a staff measure. The default shows **faculty FTE (solid) and non-faculty FTE (dashed)** together: full-time staff plus one-third of part-time staff, with graduate assistants counted separately rather than as faculty. Each panel is one sector of surviving institutions (the same colleges in every year). The shaded years are the ones the 2014 brief covered. The red dashed line marks the 2012–13 redesign of the IPEDS staff survey. Faculty FTE, non-faculty FTE and full-time faculty are continuous across it at the median institution. Part-time faculty, graduate assistants and the part-time share are spliced at the redesign, and executive, professional and nonprofessional staff were reclassified, so those measures (and the v1 headcounts that contain them) are drawn as two separate segments and should only be compared within a segment.

{{< include ../_toggles.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
TRM = ["pair", ...MEAS.map(d => d.k).filter(k => k !== "pair" && TR.some(d => d.m === k))]
viewof meas = measSelect(TRM, {value: param("m", "pair"), label: "Staff measure"})
viewof secSel = Inputs.select(["all", ...SECTORS.map(d => d.k)], {format: k => k === "all" ? "All sectors (small multiples)" : SECL[k], value: param("sector", "all"), label: "Sector"})
viewof view = Inputs.radio(new Map([["Chart", "chart"], ["Table", "table"]]), {value: param("view", "chart"), label: "View"})
viewof hc = Inputs.toggle({label: "Add v1 headcount (grey) for reference", value: param("hc", "0") === "1"})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
v = d => wt === "w" ? d.w : d.unw
MS = meas === "pair" ? PAIR : [meas]
isShare = meas === "ptshare"
rowsM = TR.filter(d => MS.includes(d.m)).map(d => ({...d, v: v(d), era: BRK.has(d.m) ? era(d.fy) : "all", lab: SECL[d.sec]}))
rowsH = hc && !isShare ? TR.filter(d => d.m === "total").map(d => ({...d, v: v(d), era: era(d.fy)})) : []
ydom = [0, d3.max([...rowsM, ...rowsH], d => d.v) * 1.05]
ylab = isShare ? "Part-time share of faculty headcount (%)" : meas === "pair" ? "Faculty FTE and non-faculty FTE per 1,000 FTE students" : `${MEASL[meas]} per 1,000 FTE students`
anyBrk = MS.some(m => BRK.has(m))
sync1 = { setParam("m", meas === "pair" ? null : meas); setParam("sector", secSel === "all" ? null : secSel); setParam("view", view === "chart" ? null : view); setParam("hc", hc ? "1" : null); return syncW; }
panel = (k, w, h, ctx) => {
  const pts = rowsM.filter(d => d.sec === k);
  const other = ctx ? rowsM.filter(d => d.sec !== k) : [];
  const hpts = rowsH.filter(d => d.sec === k);
  const ends = MS.map(m => pts.filter(d => d.m === m).at(-1));
  return Plot.plot({
    width: w, height: h, marginLeft: 40, marginRight: ctx ? 130 : 12, marginTop: 24,
    title: ctx ? null : SECL[k],
    x: {...yearAxis, domain: [1987, 2026], ticks: w < 300 ? [1990, 2000, 2010, 2020] : 8},
    y: {domain: ydom, grid: true, label: ctx ? ylab : null},
    marks: [
      Plot.rectX([{a: 1989.5, b: 2012.5}], {x1: "a", x2: "b", fill: SHADE}),
      Plot.ruleX([2012.5], {stroke: BREAKC, strokeDasharray: "4,3", strokeOpacity: anyBrk ? 0.9 : 0.35}),
      ctx ? Plot.lineY(other, {x: "fy", y: "v", z: d => d.sec + d.m + d.era, stroke: "#c9d1d9", strokeWidth: 1}) : null,
      Plot.lineY(hpts, {x: "fy", y: "v", z: "era", stroke: GRAY, strokeWidth: 1.2, strokeOpacity: 0.8}),
      ...MS.map(m => Plot.lineY(pts.filter(d => d.m === m), {x: "fy", y: "v", z: "era", stroke: SECC[k], strokeWidth: 2.2, strokeDasharray: meas === "pair" ? PAIRDASH[m] : null})),
      Plot.dot(pts.filter(d => [2000, 2012, 2013, 2024].includes(d.fy)), {x: "fy", y: "v", r: 3, fill: SECC[k], stroke: "white"}),
      ctx ? Plot.text(ends, {x: "fy", y: "v", text: d => `${meas === "pair" ? PAIRL[d.m] : SECL[k]} ${isShare ? f1(d.v) + "%" : f0(d.v)}`, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: INK, fontSize: 11}) : null,
      ctx && hpts.length ? Plot.text([hpts.at(-1)], {x: "fy", y: "v", text: d => `Headcount (v1) ${f0(d.v)}`, dx: 6, textAnchor: "start", fill: GRAY, fontSize: 10}) : null,
      Plot.tip(pts, Plot.pointer({x: "fy", y: "v", title: d => `${SECL[k]}, FY${d.fy}\n${MEASL[d.m]}: ${f1(d.v)}${isShare ? "%" : " per 1,000"} (${wlab})\n${d.n} institutions${BRK.has(d.m) ? (d.fy >= 2013 ? "\npost-2013 HR scheme" : "\npre-2013 HR scheme") : ""}`}))
    ]
  });
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
**Data.** IPEDS Human Resources and 12-month/fall enrollment, rebuilt from the item-3 staffing panel and its faculty/non-faculty split. FTE staff = full-time + one-third of part-time; faculty FTE excludes graduate assistants (Delta Cost counted them as part-time faculty); the v1 headcounts count every employee once. **S24**: the 1,909 surviving institutions (extension groups containing a Delta Cost 26-year matched campus) with staff and fall FTE students in FY1990, 2000, 2010, 2012 and every year FY2013–2025. Fiscal year *t* staff are counted in fall *t*−1. Even years only before FY2012 (the odd years FY2003–11 have partial coverage). FY2024 and FY2025 IPEDS values are NCES provisional. Because the set requires survival to 2025, FY1990–2012 values sit 0–14 per 1,000 above the brief's; the replication below uses the brief's own matched set.
:::

## Replication: the 2014 brief, rebuilt

The brief's Appendix Tables 1–3 (headcounts, the brief's own measures), recomputed two ways for its own 26-year matched set: from the Delta Cost Project database and from a clean rebuild of IPEDS. Rings are the brief's published values.

```{ojs}
REPM = new Map([["Total headcount", "total_headcount"], ["FTE staff", "fte_staff"], ["Full-time faculty", "ft_faculty"], ["Part-time faculty (incl. graduate assistants, Delta definition)", "pt_faculty"], ["EAM", "eam"], ["Professional", "professional"], ["Nonprofessional", "nonprofessional"]])
viewof repm = Inputs.select(REPM, {value: param("rm", "total_headcount"), label: "Measure"})
viewof repy = Inputs.radio([1990, 2000, 2010, 2012], {value: +param("ry", 2012), format: d => `FY${d}`, label: "Fiscal year"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("rm", repm === "total_headcount" ? null : repm); setParam("ry", repy === 2012 ? null : repy);
  const r = REP.filter(d => d.measure === repm && d.fy === repy);
  const pts = r.flatMap(d => [{sec: d.sec, src: "Delta Cost database", v: d.dcp}, {sec: d.sec, src: "Clean IPEDS rebuild", v: d.clean}]);
  const dom = SECTORS.map(s => SECL[s.k]);
  return html`${Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 820), height: 300, marginLeft: 140, marginRight: 30,
    x: {label: "Per 1,000 FTE students", grid: true}, y: {domain: dom, label: null},
    color: {domain: ["Delta Cost database", "Clean IPEDS rebuild"], range: [GRAY, BLUE], legend: true},
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(r, {y: d => SECL[d.sec], x: "brief", r: 9, stroke: INK, strokeWidth: 1.5, title: d => `Brief: ${f0(d.brief)}`}),
      Plot.dot(pts, {y: d => SECL[d.sec], x: "v", fill: "src", r: 4.5, stroke: "white", title: d => `${d.src}: ${f1(d.v)}`}),
      Plot.tip(r, Plot.pointerY({y: d => SECL[d.sec], x: "clean", title: d => `${SECL[d.sec]}, FY${d.fy}\nbrief ${f0(d.brief)}\nDCP database ${f1(d.dcp)}\nclean rebuild ${f1(d.clean)}\n${d.n} institutions`}))
    ]
  })}<p class="cs-note">Ring: the brief's value (rounded to whole numbers in the brief). Both rebuilds match it within about 1 per 1,000 in FY2010 and FY2012 for most cells. Source: replication gate, item 3 (DCP 26-year matched set; mean of institution ratios).</p>`;
}
```

## Spending stalled after 2017

The brief's finance measures, carried forward for the F13 finance set (institutions with every finance input in every year FY2013–2024). Real growth was positive to FY2017 and turned negative in most measures over FY2017–24, when inflation outran budgets.

```{ojs}
FM = new Map(d3.groups(FIN, d => d.measure).map(([k, v]) => [v[0].label, k]))
viewof finm = Inputs.select(FM, {value: param("fm", "ft_faculty_avg_salary"), label: "Measure"})
```

```{ojs}
{
  setParam("fm", finm === "ft_faculty_avg_salary" ? null : finm);
  const WIN = ["FY2002-FY2010", "FY2013-FY2017", "FY2017-FY2024"];
  const WL = {"FY2002-FY2010": "FY2002–10 (replication)", "FY2013-FY2017": "FY2013–17", "FY2017-FY2024": "FY2017–24"};
  const r = FIN.filter(d => d.measure === finm && WIN.includes(d.window)).map(d => ({...d, wl: WL[d.window], sl: SECL[d.sec]}));
  return Plot.plot({
    width: Math.min(width, 820), height: 40 + SECTORS.length * 3 * 15 + 30, marginLeft: 140, marginRight: 50,
    x: {label: "Real average annual % change", grid: true, insetLeft: 30, insetRight: 30}, y: {domain: Object.values(WL), axis: null},
    fy: {domain: SECTORS.map(s => s.l), label: null},
    color: {domain: Object.values(WL), range: ["#c3ccd5", LIGHT, BLUE], legend: true},
    marks: [Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: INK}),
      Plot.barX(r, {fy: "sl", y: "wl", x: "pct", fill: "wl", inset: 1}),
      Plot.text(r.filter(d => d.pct < 0), {fy: "sl", y: "wl", x: "pct", text: d => s1(d.pct), dx: -4, textAnchor: "end", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.text(r.filter(d => d.pct >= 0), {fy: "sl", y: "wl", x: "pct", text: d => s1(d.pct), dx: 4, textAnchor: "start", fontSize: 10, fill: INK}),
      Plot.tip(r, Plot.pointerY({fy: "sl", y: "wl", x: "pct", title: d => `${d.sl}, ${d.wl}\n${s1(d.pct)}%/yr${d.brief != null && isFinite(d.brief) ? `\nbrief: ${d.brief}` : ""}`}))]
  });
}
```

::: {.cs-note}
CAGR of each sector's mean real institution value, deflated by CPI-U fiscal-year averages, as in the brief. Replication FY2002–10 uses the Delta Cost database's 11-year set and matches the brief within ±0.1 point in almost every cell. Extension windows start in FY2013 because the IPEDS salary survey was redesigned then; total salaries have a +1.1% step at FY2016. FY2024 finance data are NCES provisional. Source: white paper Appendix (exhibits, item 5).
:::
